name: ungaga-c10b
why: Ungaga's DC1 dungeon body (dun/mainchara/c10b.chr, model c10a.mds, 67 frames, skin 'skin' 18 bones / 2 influences) in DC2's player slot (wave5-ungaga section 3). He has no footl/footr/keri/bcol frames, so keri_L, keri_R, bcol00 and bcol01 are synthesised under his own feet and spine; weapon/item/eff3 are renamed to Max's sockets. KEY 0-39 stay DC1 slots dc1_00..dc1_39 (his combo is 37-39, charge 13-15); Max's 46 KEY names follow as aliases.

eff3: obj 56, end of the head chain jnt3_1, bind (0, 21.5, -0.5): head top; Max's head socket (charasetup.cpp:210, 507)
